text.quarkos_capes.title: QuarkOS Capes
text.quarkos_capes.gallery.title: Cape Gallery
text.quarkos_capes.gallery.quiet: Gallery stays quiet while offline mode is on.
text.quarkos_capes.status.select_report: Equip a gallery cape before reporting.
text.quarkos_capes.status.session_failed: The gallery could not confirm this session.
text.quarkos_capes.sources.help: Enable a source to show capes worn by other players. Offline disables all requests.
text.quarkos_capes.gallery.search_hint: Search local samples and the shared gallery. Shared capes require online mode.
text.quarkos_capes.button.reload_hint: Reload the last saved settings. Changes save automatically.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.equip: Wear this cape locally. This does not publish it.
text.quarkos_capes.status.publish_offlin: Publish did not sign in. Offline mode is on.
text.quarkos_capes.status.no_token: This session has no Mojang access token, so hasJoined cannot run.
text.quarkos_capes.status.no_challenge: The gallery service did not issue a challenge.
text.quarkos_capes.status.no_session: The gallery service did not return a session.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.flat: Use the vanilla cape shape and movement.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.frames: Animate the frames in a horizontal texture strip.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.animation: Play the texture strip using its frame delays.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.back: Turn the preview to show the cape.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.classic: Bend the cape using player movement.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.simulation: Simulate forward motion without sideways sway.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.simulation_v2: Simulate forward motion and sideways sway.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.blocky: Add a back surface to the cloth.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.gravity_vecto: Use the player pose to influence gravity.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.show_others: Show custom capes worn by other players.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.local_only: Disable all gallery and cape service requests.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.elytra: Use compatible cape textures on elytra.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.optifine: Show capes worn through OptiFine. Online mode required.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.labymod: Show other players’ LabyMod capes and cloaks. Online mode required.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.minecraftcape: Show capes worn through MinecraftCapes. Online mode required.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.cosmetica: Show capes worn through Cosmetica. Online mode required.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.cloaksplus: Show capes worn through Cloaks+. Online mode required.
text.quarkos_capes.status.busy: Cape service is busy. Try again shortly.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.previous: Try the previous catalog texture. Developer mode only.
text.quarkos_capes.tooltip.next: Try the next catalog texture. Developer mode only.
